title: Being affine is fpqc local on the base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the property 'f is affine' is fpqc local on the base (statement lines 6142-6146). The proof records base-change stability and Zariski locality, then treats the case of a flat surjective morphism of affines S' -> S with affine base change X' = Spec(A'): using the descending lemmas for quasi-compactness and separatedness, f is seen to be separated and quasi-compact, so f_* O_X is a quasi-coherent sheaf of O_S-algebras equal to the tilde of A = Gamma(X, O_X); flat base change identifies A' with R' tensor_R A; the canonical morphism X -> Spec(A) therefore becomes an isomorphism after base change to S', hence is an isomorphism by the descending-property-isomorphism lemma, and the general descending-properties lemma concludes (proof lines 6148-6181). The level is H3: the argument makes and uses a concrete identification of A' by flat base change and finishes with a genuine descent of an isomorphism.
